name: Mahatma Gandhi
description: Mahatma Gandhi, a historic building in Trincomalee, Sri Lanka, stands as a tribute to the Indian independence leader. Built in 1938 by the British, it was used as a rest house for visiting dignitaries. Gandhi himself visited in 1934, leaving behind a message inscribed on the wall. Today, it attracts visitors interested in its historical context and serves as a reminder of the region's colonial past and Gandhi's influence. Nearby, you can explore ancient temples and enjoy scenic coastal views.
